valor: Un comentario misógino de la manosfera, que describe a la Virgen María como la mujer ideal, impulsa a dos cineastas a explorar cómo se la entiende hoy. A partir de una llamada al Vaticano, su investigación recorre ámbitos políticos y personales, retratando una figura sobre la que aún se proyectan deseos e ideologías contradictorios.

valor: A misogynistic remark from the „manosphere“, describing the Holy Mary as the ideal woman, impulses two women filmmakers to explore how Mary is understood today. Starting with a phone call to the Vatican, their research takes them into political and personal spheres, painting a picture of a figure onto whom contradictory desires and ideologies are still projected to this day.
